items.headline: Rupee ends flat, anchored by RBI intervention in face of global strains
items.teaser: The Indian rupee ended little changed on Monday, bolstered by central bank interventions during ongoing pressures. A firmer dollar was ob…
items.story: The Indian rupee ended little changed on Monday, bolstered by central bank interventions during ongoing pressures. A firmer dollar was observed, approaching a 17-month high due to a weak euro's impact. Crude oil prices increased to nearly $103 per barrel, posing risks to India's economy. India's Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that trade talks with the United States reached a plateau.

items.story: The ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 is scheduled for October 8, 2026, in Mumbai. This event will gather various investment professionals including high-net-worth individuals and family offices. Some of the discussions will focus on the implications of AI for portfolio management and investment allocation. Expert sessions will explore the balance between human judgement and AI in making investment decisions.

items.headline: India’s BPCL plans $3 billion bond sale to fund Brazil oil bet
items.teaser: Bharat Petroleum Corp. plans to raise up to $3 billion through international bonds, mainly funding its $2.8 billion contribution to Brazi…
items.story: Bharat Petroleum Corp. plans to raise up to $3 billion through international bonds, mainly funding its $2.8 billion contribution to Brazil’s SEAP-I offshore project and refinancing debt. The move supports India’s push to diversify crude supplies amid geopolitical disruptions. BPCL’s Brazil investment highlights growing interest in South American energy assets.

items.headline: Sebi to partly reverse derivative settlement rules after pushback: Report
items.teaser: Sebi is likely to change its closing auction mechanism after sharp derivatives price swings on expiry days. The regulator may stop using …
items.story: Sebi is likely to change its closing auction mechanism after sharp derivatives price swings on expiry days. The regulator may stop using the closing auction for derivatives settlement for at least a year, shifting to a 30-minute volume-weighted average price, while retaining the auction for less-liquid underlying stocks.

items.headline: Scientists discover a human brain gene that can jump through DNA
items.teaser: Scientists have discovered a human gene with a remarkable double life: it appears to play an important role in brain cells while still re…
items.story: Scientists have discovered a human gene with a remarkable double life: it appears to play an important role in brain cells while still retaining the ability to jump around the genome. Called BC200, the gene evolved millions of years ago from a mobile piece of DNA known as a transposon, but unlike most genes that arose this way, it never lost its mobility. Researchers even found BC200 embedded inside a human poxvirus, suggesting it may have jumped from infected skin cells into the virus.

items.headline: Cancer-fighting t cells burn out. Scientists may have found a fix
items.teaser: Cancer immunotherapy can lose its punch when tumor-fighting T cells become exhausted, but researchers may have found a way to keep them g…
items.story: Cancer immunotherapy can lose its punch when tumor-fighting T cells become exhausted, but researchers may have found a way to keep them going longer. Scientists at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center identified a signaling molecule called MEK that can push T cells to burn through their energy while producing cancer-killing proteins. In animal and laboratory studies, blocking MEK helped the cells conserve energy, survive longer, and remain active even in the harsh environment around tumors.
